BJP Leader Calls for Women's Empowerment, Cites Cooperative Model

Senior Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader Sanjay Tandon advocated for women's empowerment, emphasizing dignity, equal opportunity, and rural entrepreneurship. Union Home Minister Amit Shah stated that empowering women through cooperatives is a key objective of the Modi government.
